caveats: This structured review uses direct inspection of the stored generated outputs plus timing metrics. It is not a semantic truth oracle.

The earlier audit incorrectly treated every source scene as mandatory in key_points. The engine schema defines key_points as selected theses and requires per-scene coverage in scene_enrichment instead.
All 18 stored outputs contain 14 unique scene_enrichment entries covering scene IDs 1-14.
The source video and raw source-scene/transcript/OCR payload are excluded.

manual_review_notes: No known garbled fragments AND JU, NC END or D_ in stored outputs.
Review factual claims and source grounding before treating baseline as production-approved.
